data.description: An innovative waterfront destination brimming with opulent resorts, pristine beaches, and vibrant cultural attractions.

data.answer:
Dubai Islands is among the palm islands in Dubai, which include Palm Jumeirah, Palm Jebel Ali, and The World. The Dubai Islands project by Nakheel Properties underwent a major transformation in mid-2022. Aligning seamlessly with the vision outlined in the Dubai 2040 Urban Master Plan, the project is a comprehensive blueprint guiding the city's future developments.

Dubai Islands Nakheel is set to accommodate an extensive array of over 80 hotels. The development will boast parks and open spaces alongside premium golf courses offering captivating views of the Arabian Gulf.

Dubai Islands Nakheel will boast various resorts, luxury hotels, and the renowned shopping destination Souk Al Marfa, formerly Deira Islands Night Souk. The developer also plans to expand the length of beaches and enhance public park areas.

Visitors will enjoy seamless connectivity via a highly integrated marina promenades and pathways system, which includes waterways, roads, and walking and cycling tracks.

Off-Plan Projects in Dubai Islands

One of the off-plan properties in Dubai Islands is Rixos Hotel and Residences. At Rixos Dubai Islands, residents and visitors alike will enjoy service and amenities synonymous with Rixos hotels worldwide. Emphasizing sports, leisure, and wellness, the facilities at this Rixos Dubai Islands hotel include communal lounges, renowned cafés and restaurants, diverse entertainment options, infinity pools, and a spa and fitness center.

Bay Villas is another upcoming residential project in the Dubai Islands. It offers opulent Dubai Islands houses that effortlessly combine urban convenience with the serene charm of island living. Prospective buyers have various options, including townhouses with 3 to 4 bedrooms, 3 and 4 BHK semi-detached villas, 4 and 5-bedroom garden villas, and 5-bedroom waterfront villas. Each Dubai Islands home for sale at Bay Villas is meticulously crafted, featuring expansive interiors, luxurious finishes, and modern fittings.

Property for Sale in Dubai Islands Area

Interested in investing in Dubai Islands for sale properties? You’ll be glad to know several residential plots are available in the community. The apartments available for sale in the Dubai Islands offer a variety of unit sizes. The pricing trends for these bed types are outlined below:

  • 1-bedroom apartments for sale on the Dubai Islands start at AED 1.6M.
  • 2-bedroom apartments for sale on Dubai Islands are available for a minimum price of AED 2M.
  • 3-bedroom apartments for sale on Dubai Islands are priced at AED 3.1M minimum.

Villas available for sale on Dubai Islands include 3 to 5-bedroom units. The minimum price of these Dubai Islands homes for sale is AED 5.2M.

more_info.question: What’s Life Like in Dubai Islands?

data.answer:
Currently under construction, the island is all set to become the ultimate family-friendly destination, offering tons of fun and excellent connectivity.

Transportation and Infrastructure in Dubai Islands Project

Note that the area is not yet directly linked with transportation in Dubai. However, like other grand projects developed by master developer Nakheel, Dubai Islands boasts a meticulously planned infrastructure with road networks, walkways, parking facilities, and entertainment venues.

The Dubai Islands project is set to have direct entry and exit points on the Bur Dubai side via a bridge that will cross the Dubai Creek. The bridge will connect the Infinity Bridge to the Port Rashid Development Project. It will have four lanes in each direction and a total capacity of 16,000 vehicles per hour.

Supermarkets in the Dubai Islands Area

There are currently limited supermarket options in Dubai Islands Nakheel, but when the properties on the island are ready to move in, there will be plenty of choices. The supermarkets within 15 minutes' driving distance from the community are Al Shams Supermarket, Big Mart Supermarket, and Royal Nova Supermarket.

Shopping Mall in Dubai Islands Project

Within the Dubai Islands lies the 1.9-kilometer wholesale market of Souk Al Marfa, which spans 1.9km along the island. The air-conditioned retail center is home to wholesale shops selling everything from automobile accessories to clothing, spices, and cosmetics. The strategic location of the marketplace near Deira Wharfage, Mina Al Hamriya, and Mina Rashid facilitates seamless shipping of goods directly to its stores and pavilions.

Souk Al Marfa is not the only retail option for residents. Deira Central is The island's centerpiece, an extraordinary retail, entertainment, and residential living hub. Additionally, the forthcoming Deira Mall is also under construction.

Schools in Dubai Islands Dubai

Currently, Dubai Islands does not have any schools or nurseries. Spectrum Nursery is the nearest option from the island. The nursery follows the EYFS curriculum and caters to children up to 4 years old. Spectrum Nursery is situated in Abu Hail, near Hamriya Park. Also located in Abu Hail, Tiny Tots Nursery is a great nearby option that is easily accessible within a 10-minute drive by car.

The Elite English School follows the Indian Central Board of Secondary Education (CBSE) curriculum. It is adjacent to the Sabari Indian School on 34 B Street in Al Wuheida. Amna Bint Wahab School for Girls is recognized as one of the premier government schools for girls in Dubai; It offers secondary education from Grade 10 to Grade 12 for girls aged 15 to 18. It is located in Deira, reachable by car in approximately 13 minutes.

Churches, Temples and Mosques in Dubai Islands Area

There will be two mosques in the area. Boasting a combined built-up area of 26,000 square feet, the mosques will simultaneously accommodate up to 1,000 residents for prayers. Additionally, a prayer room in Souk Al Marfa is conveniently accessible within a 7-minute drive.

Nearby mosques include Masjid Haji Nasser, Hamriyah Mosque, and Al Waheeda Mosque, all reachable within an 8 to 12-minute drive.

There is no temple or church in the area. However, the Dubai Temple in Old Textile Market is about 26 minutes from Dubai Islands Nakheel, and St. Mary's Catholic Church, Dubai, at Oud Mehta Road, is about 33 minutes away.

Clinics and Hospitals in Dubai Islands

Currently, there are no hospitals or clinics in the Dubai Islands area. However, residents can easily access numerous healthcare facilities nearby on the mainland. Several notable hospitals are available in the Deira area and are easily accessible via the bridge. These include Kuwait Hospital and Dubai Hospital, both situated approximately 12 minutes away by car.

Dubai Islands Location & Nearby Areas

Dubai Islands benefits from a distinctive geographical position, offering proximity to the city's center while maintaining its island charm. It is 20 minutes from Dubai International Airport and 24 minutes from Dubai World Trade Centre and Downtown Dubai. Dubai Islands is situated adjacent to Al Mamzar Dubai and Deira. Linked to Deira Corniche and the central district through road bridges, the island enjoys proximity to Al Hamriya Port.

more_info.question: Things to Do in Dubai Islands Nakheel

data.answer:
Explore a world of endless possibilities on Dubai Islands by Nakheel. Unwind on pristine beaches, indulge in luxury shopping, and savor gourmet dining experiences overlooking the shimmering waters.

Dubai Islands Restaurants and Bars

Besides shopping, you can also visit Souq Al Marfa to explore the dining options. Some popular restaurants in the souq area are Bait Al Zain Mandi Restaurant, Al Tayar Al Jadeed Restaurant, Hadiqat Al Shay, Dosa Express, Hong Kong Restaurant, Helw Al Shai, Marfa Biryani, and Juice Hut.

The Delhi Restaurant, Chili’s, and Casrod Restaurant at Deira are located a short drive from the Dubai Islands project.

Beaches Near Dubai Islands Location

Dubai Islands Beach, named after its waterfront community, is the city's newest hotspot for seaside relaxation and entertainment. It is a fully pet-friendly beach adjacent to Dubai's historic Deira district, welcoming pet parents to enjoy scenic jogs or swims with their canine companions.

Once the island project is completed, there will be an impressive 20 kilometers of pristine Dubai Island beaches, including a 'Blue Flag' certified beach.

Hotels in the Dubai Islands Area

Once fully operational, Dubai Islands is poised to become one of the premier tourist destinations in Dubai. Collaborating with several international hospitality brands, Nakheel aims to introduce innovative tourism concepts to the city.

We have already discussed the upcoming Rixos Dubai Island. Other standout hotels within the Dubai Islands include Centara Deira Islands Beach Resort Dubai. This family-friendly beach resort offers 607 guestrooms. The rooms and suites offer breathtaking city or sea views, with the option of bunk beds for added flexibility. The resort boasts two remarkable beachfront swimming pools complete with waterslides.

Additionally, it features three Kids' Clubs tailored to different age groups, a delightful candy-themed kids' spa, an outdoor playground, and a fully equipped fitness center.

Another option is the Hotel RIU Dubai. Nestled along the beachfront of Dubai Islands, Nakheel RIU Deira Islands Hotel is a 4-star hotel that provides guests with an impressive array of facilities. The 24-hour all-inclusive hotel offers elegant accommodations with sea-view rooms and access to a water park.

Outdoor Activities in Dubai Islands

The area's hotels and resorts offer excellent outdoor activities, including swimming pools, tennis courts, and badminton courts. Additionally, Deira Central is set to feature numerous family recreational facilities, such as multifunctional sports courts, skateparks, playgrounds, fitness facilities, and parks.

The cost of living on Dubai Island can be relatively high, given the luxurious properties and facilities available in the area. Also, like Palm Jumeirah, residents of Dubai Island must ideally have their car for the commute.

Where is The Dubai Islands?

Dubai Islands is a district within Deira, a prominent area in Dubai. It consists of five islands covering a combined area of 17 sq. km.

Are Dubai Islands man made?

Yes. Dubai is home to several of the largest man-made islands in the world, including the Dubai Islands.

How was Dubai Islands made?

The artificial islands were created by dredging sand from the Gulf and transporting it to the designated location, where several million tons of rocks were used to secure them.

Who made Dubai Islands?

Nakheel is the developer of Dubai Islands and the mastermind behind Palm Jumeira Island. It’s a real estate company now owned by the government of Dubai.

What is Deira Islands Boulevard Towers?

Deira Island Towers is a 27-storey residential building planned for the community.

How many palms are there in Dubai?

Dubai is home to three man-made palm-shaped islands along its coast: Palm Jumeirah, Dubai Islands, The World Islands and Palm Jebel Ali.

When will Dubai Islands be opened?

The latest pictures of the Dubai Islands show that the project is still under development. According to Nakheel, the Central Island district will be handed over in the third quarter of 2025.

Which Dubai island has the Heart of Europe?

The Heart of Europe is located within The World Islands, an archipelago of artificial islands constructed off the coast of Dubai.

What types of properties are available on the Dubai Islands?

The Dubai Islands offer luxury villas, apartments, and hotels.

What are the main amenities and facilities on the Dubai Islands?

Main amenities and facilities include private beaches, marinas, shopping centers, restaurants, and entertainment venues.

How is transportation on the Dubai Islands?

Transportation is well-developed with road connections to mainland Dubai and planned public transport options.

data.content:
Previously known as Deira Islands, Dubai Islands has a distinct charm and character, redefining the concept of exclusive waterfront living. The development will offer its residents a global architectural splendor and an unmatched lifestyle experience.

It is an ongoing project set to encompass a 17 sq. km. area spread across five interconnected isles off the coast of Deira. Shore Island, Marina Island, Elite Island, Central Island, and Golf Island are the names of the islets forming Dubai Islands. Once fully developed, each sub-community will have a mix of residential and resort properties.

At Dubai Islands, residents will enjoy an array of world-class amenities, including private beaches, shopping centers, golf courses, wellness facilities, parks, restaurants, and entertainment hubs, ensuring every aspect of their lifestyle is catered to with the utmost sophistication and comfort.

Kaia Residences by Amwaj Development introduces an exceptional blend of modern design and serene island living. Residents will enjoy a wide array of world-class amenities, including a crystal infinity pool, fully-equipped gyms, a gaming lounge, and a tranquil Mala garden.
